player_entry_points: A new shoreline reclamation project has been announced, sparking debate over its impact on sea access.
The Courthouse is holding a public auction of confiscated goods, some of which are valuable construction materials.
A community forum is scheduled to discuss recent changes to neighborhood sea access.

creator_conflict_hooks: A new reclamation project is proposed that would significantly improve sea access for Inland Merchants but completely landlock a long-standing Coastal Resident neighborhood.

A critical section of the shoreline collapses due to poor construction or unexpected erosion, and the Reclamation Guild blames the quality of materials provided by the Courthouse, while Coastal Residents blame the Guild's engineering.

image_generation.default_prompt_template: {domain_label}. Create one polished still image of {image_subject} for {actor_name} and {target_name}. Emphasize lived-in civic interiors, notices, ledgers, and social coordination pressure. No visible text, no watermark.

asset_prompt_policy.world_visual_anchor: Civic interiors, notices, ledgers, tea, access markers, and social negotiation.

item_catalog.name: Smuggler's Compass
item_catalog.description: A tarnished brass compass, rumored to point not north, but towards the nearest hidden cove. Confiscated from a notorious sea-runner.
item_catalog.image_prompt: Tarnished brass compass with intricate, worn carvings, pointing towards a hidden cove on a map.

item_catalog.name: Illicit Dredge Permit
item_catalog.description: A forged permit for unauthorized seabed dredging, bearing a suspiciously official-looking seal. Evidence of past illegal resource extraction.
item_catalog.image_prompt: Aged, slightly crumpled legal document with a forged seal, titled 'Dredging Permit'.

item_catalog.name: Gilded Spyglass
item_catalog.description: A beautifully crafted spyglass with a gold-leaf finish, once belonging to a wealthy, now-exiled land speculator.
item_catalog.image_prompt: Ornate gilded spyglass, reflecting the sun on a dynamic coastal landscape.

item_catalog.name: Reclaimed Pier Timber
item_catalog.description: Heavy, salt-weathered timber salvaged from a collapsed pier. Ideal for reinforcing new shoreline structures or whimsical architecture.
item_catalog.image_prompt: Stack of heavy, salt-weathered timber beams salvaged from an old pier, on a gritty beach.

item_catalog.name: Shoreline Configuration Report
item_catalog.description: A detailed report outlining current erosion rates and sediment distribution along a specific coastal section. Essential for reclamation planning.
item_catalog.image_prompt: Technical survey document with maps and data charts, showing shoreline erosion.

item_catalog.name: Kelp Bloom Fertilizer
item_catalog.description: Rich, nutrient-dense fertilizer made from processed coastal kelp blooms. Boosts growth of resilient coastal flora.
item_catalog.image_prompt: Bag of dark green, organic fertilizer made from kelp, next to thriving coastal plants.

item_catalog.name: Official Court Summons
item_catalog.description: A formal legal document requiring appearance before the Island Courthouse. Ignoring it has severe consequences.
item_catalog.image_prompt: Official-looking court summons document with a prominent seal and formal typography.

item_catalog.name: Reclamation Guild Membership Card
item_catalog.description: A laminated card signifying active membership in the Coastal Reclamation Guild, granting access to material supply chains and project bids.
item_catalog.image_prompt: Laminated membership card with the Coastal Reclamation Guild logo and a unique ID number.

item_catalog.name: Coastal Property Deed
item_catalog.description: A legal deed for a prime piece of coastal property, its value fluctuating wildly with changes in sea access and reclamation projects.
item_catalog.image_prompt: Official property deed document with intricate borders and a legal seal, showing a coastal plot.

item_catalog.name: Sustainable Crab Trap Blueprints
item_catalog.description: Detailed blueprints for building efficient, sustainable crab traps, designed to minimize bycatch and support local fishing.
item_catalog.image_prompt: Technical blueprints for a sustainable crab trap, with measurements and material lists.

item_catalog.name: Community Council Minutes
item_catalog.description: Official record of a Community Council public hearing, detailing resident feedback and objections to a proposed reclamation project.
item_catalog.image_prompt: Typed document showing meeting minutes, with signatures and a 'Community Council' header.

item_catalog.name: Ancient Coral Fragment
item_catalog.description: A large, beautifully preserved fragment of fossilized coral, often used as a decorative element in found-object architecture.
item_catalog.image_prompt: Large, intricate fragment of fossilized coral, displaying unique textures and colors.

item_catalog.name: Hand-Drawn Tide Chart (Ancient)
item_catalog.description: A weathered, hand-drawn tide chart passed down through generations, surprisingly accurate for predicting local currents.
item_catalog.image_prompt: Aged, parchment-like hand-drawn tide chart with intricate symbols and notes.

item_catalog.name: Approved Reclamation Permit
item_catalog.description: A Courthouse-issued permit authorizing specific shoreline reclamation work, detailing approved materials and scope.
item_catalog.image_prompt: Official government permit document with a large 'APPROVED' stamp and Courthouse seal.

item_catalog.name: Eelgrass Seedling Bundle
item_catalog.description: A small bundle of resilient eelgrass seedlings, vital for stabilizing new shorelines and restoring marine habitats.
item_catalog.image_prompt: Small bundle of vibrant green eelgrass seedlings, ready for planting.

item_catalog.name: Task Ledger
item_catalog.description: A notebook tracking obligations and favors.

item_catalog.name: Meeting Notice
item_catalog.description: A posted notice calling people into a room.

item_catalog.name: Tea Coupon
item_catalog.description: A voucher used to keep long discussions moving.
